name: isc
description: The end-of-life ISC DHCP plugin: probed for its presence and never read, because its lease contract is unverified (data source 4).

endpoints.name: status
endpoints.note: 404 means the end-of-life plugin is not installed. /api/dhcpv4/leases/searchLease answered 404 on a live 26.7.3_11, so no lease read is attempted. See also https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/kea.html
